readable_name: MechET USPTO-50K standard product-only K=10 (8xV100, kernel Ceph)
task_description: Frozen USPTO-50K product-only K=10 inference on FP16 V100, using runtime keyring plus kernel Ceph mount after FUSE incompatibility.
init_cmd: test -x ./taiji_client && mkdir -p /etc/ceph /aaa/fionafyang && export PATH="$PWD/ceph_rootfs/usr/bin:$PATH" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/ceph_rootfs/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ceph:$PWD/ceph_rootfs/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:$PWD/ceph_rootfs/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && (./taiji_client mount -l cq -tk "$TAIJI_API_TOKEN" /aaa/fionafyang || true) && test -s /etc/ceph/ceph.client.whaleywang.keyring && runtime_ceph_secret="$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*key[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p' /etc/ceph/ceph.client.whaleywang.keyring | head -1)" && test -n "$runtime_ceph_secret" && mount -t ceph '11.96.232.117:6789,11.96.232.126:6789,11.96.236.86:6789:/user/whaleywang' /aaa/fionafyang -o "name=whaleywang,secret=$runtime_ceph_secret" && unset runtime_ceph_secret && test -d /aaa/fionafyang/buddy1/whaleywang/MechET
